units.source_text: 古埃及格调高雅的抒情诗——《亡灵书》上的转世歌是最淳朴的。

en.t: Among the elegant lyric poems of ancient Egypt, the song of reincarnation in the Book of the Dead is the most simple and pure.

units.source_text: 希腊神话中的伊里斯用彩虹织成的衣服，是最明亮的光。

en.t: In Greek mythology, the garment Iris wove from the rainbow is the brightest light.

units.source_text: 白莲花的转世，是最开朗的喜悦。

en.t: The reincarnation of the white lotus is the most open and radiant joy.
